name: test case
example: Please add a test case for an empty shopping cart.
exampleTrans: 请为空购物车添加一个测试用例。

name: bug
example: I found a bug in the login page after the latest deploy.
exampleTrans: 最近一次部署后，我在登录页面发现了一个缺陷。

name: defect
example: We logged twelve defects during the first round of system testing.
exampleTrans: 在第一轮系统测试中我们记录了十二个缺陷。

name: reproduce
example: I can reproduce the crash every time on Android devices.
exampleTrans: 我每次都能在安卓设备上复现这个崩溃。

name: steps to reproduce
example: Please include clear steps to reproduce in every bug report.
exampleTrans: 请在每份缺陷报告中写清楚复现步骤。

name: expected result
example: The expected result is a confirmation email within one minute.
exampleTrans: 预期结果是一分钟内收到确认邮件。

name: actual result
example: The actual result is a blank page with no error message.
exampleTrans: 实际结果是一个没有任何错误信息的空白页面。

name: severity
example: I set the severity to critical because users lose their data.
exampleTrans: 我把严重程度设为致命，因为用户会丢失数据。

name: priority
example: The product owner raised the priority of this bug to high.
exampleTrans: 产品负责人把这个缺陷的优先级提到了高。

name: test plan
example: The test plan describes scope, schedule, resources and exit criteria.
exampleTrans: 测试计划描述了范围、进度、资源和退出标准。

name: regression
trans: n. 回归（缺陷）；回归测试
example: This regression was introduced by yesterday's release of the billing service.
exampleTrans: 这个回归问题是昨天的发布引入的。

name: regression test
example: We run the full regression test suite before every major release.
exampleTrans: 每次大版本发布前，我们都会运行完整的回归测试套件。

name: coverage
example: Our unit test coverage dropped below eighty percent this sprint.
exampleTrans: 这个迭代我们的单元测试覆盖率降到了百分之八十以下。

name: verify
example: Please verify the fix on the staging environment before closing the ticket.
exampleTrans: 请在关闭工单前在预发布环境验证修复。

name: test suite
example: The nightly test suite takes about forty minutes to run.
exampleTrans: 每晚的测试套件大约需要运行四十分钟。

name: test data
example: We generate fresh test data before each automated run.
exampleTrans: 每次自动化运行前我们都会生成新的测试数据。

name: test environment
example: The test environment was down for two hours this morning.
exampleTrans: 今天上午测试环境宕机了两个小时。

name: precondition
example: The precondition is that the user already has an active account.
exampleTrans: 前置条件是用户已经拥有一个已激活的账户。

name: edge case
trans: n. 边缘情况；极端情况
example: We missed an edge case where the username contains emoji.
exampleTrans: 我们漏掉了用户名包含表情符号的边缘情况。

name: corner case
trans: n. 极端情况；罕见组合情况
example: This corner case only happens on leap years at midnight.
exampleTrans: 这种极端情况只会在闰年的午夜发生。

name: boundary
example: Test the boundary values of zero and the maximum allowed quantity.
exampleTrans: 测试零和最大允许数量这些边界值。

name: boundary value
example: Boundary value analysis found an off-by-one error in pagination.
exampleTrans: 边界值分析在分页功能中发现了一个差一错误。

name: sanity test
example: Run a quick sanity test after the configuration change.
exampleTrans: 配置修改后请快速做一次健全性测试。

name: end-to-end
example: Our end-to-end tests cover the full checkout flow in the browser.
exampleTrans: 我们的端到端测试覆盖了浏览器中完整的结账流程。

name: system test
example: System test starts once all modules are deployed together.
exampleTrans: 所有模块一起部署后开始系统测试。

name: acceptance test
example: The client will run the acceptance test next Monday.
exampleTrans: 客户将在下周一进行验收测试。

name: UAT
example: UAT is scheduled for two weeks before the go-live date.
exampleTrans: 用户验收测试安排在上线前两周。

name: functional test
example: Functional tests check that each feature behaves as specified.
exampleTrans: 功能测试检查每个功能是否按规格运行。

name: performance test
example: The performance test shows response times above two seconds under load.
exampleTrans: 性能测试显示在负载下响应时间超过两秒。

name: load test
example: We ran a load test with five thousand concurrent users.
exampleTrans: 我们用五千个并发用户做了一次负载测试。

name: stress test
example: The stress test crashed the service at around ten thousand requests.
exampleTrans: 压力测试在大约一万个请求时把服务压垮了。

name: exploratory testing
example: Exploratory testing uncovered three usability issues the scripts missed.
exampleTrans: 探索性测试发现了三个脚本遗漏的可用性问题。

name: manual testing
example: Manual testing is still needed for the new onboarding screens.
exampleTrans: 新的引导页面仍然需要手工测试。

name: automation
example: Test automation saves us two days of work every release.
exampleTrans: 测试自动化每次发布能为我们节省两天工作量。

name: automated test
example: This automated test runs on every pull request.
exampleTrans: 这个自动化测试会在每个拉取请求上运行。

name: test script
example: I updated the test script after the button labels changed.
exampleTrans: 按钮文字改了之后，我更新了测试脚本。

name: assertion
example: The assertion failed because the status code was 500.
exampleTrans: 断言失败了，因为状态码是五百。

name: assert
example: The test should assert that the total price includes tax.
exampleTrans: 该测试应断言总价包含税费。

name: flaky
trans: adj. 不稳定的（时过时不过的）
example: This flaky test fails about once in every twenty runs.
exampleTrans: 这个不稳定的测试大约每运行二十次失败一次。

name: stub
example: Replace the email service with a stub in unit tests.
exampleTrans: 在单元测试中用桩替换邮件服务。

name: fixture
trans: n. 测试夹具；固定测试数据
example: The fixture creates a test user before each case runs.
exampleTrans: 该夹具会在每个用例运行前创建一个测试用户。

name: CI
example: All tests passed locally but failed on CI.
exampleTrans: 所有测试在本地都通过了，但在持续集成上失败了。

name: showstopper
trans: n. 致命问题；阻止发布的问题
example: Data loss on upgrade is a showstopper for this version.
exampleTrans: 升级时丢数据是这个版本的致命问题。

name: critical
example: Mark it critical if the core feature is completely unusable.
exampleTrans: 如果核心功能完全不可用，就标记为致命。

name: major
example: It is a major issue but there is a simple workaround.
exampleTrans: 这是一个严重问题，但有一个简单的变通办法。

name: minor
example: The alignment problem is minor and can wait until next sprint.
exampleTrans: 这个对齐问题很轻微，可以等到下个迭代再处理。

name: trivial
example: Typos in tooltips are usually logged as trivial.
exampleTrans: 提示文字中的拼写错误通常记为微不足道级别。

name: triage
example: We triage new bugs every morning with the developers.
exampleTrans: 我们每天早上和开发一起对新缺陷进行分诊。

name: sign-off
trans: n. 签字确认；批准发布
example: QA sign-off is required before the release can go out.
exampleTrans: 发布前必须获得测试团队的签字确认。

name: root cause
example: The root cause was a missing index on the orders table.
exampleTrans: 根本原因是订单表缺少索引。

name: intermittent
example: The timeout is intermittent and only appears under heavy traffic.
exampleTrans: 这个超时是间歇性的，只在流量大时出现。

name: reproducible
example: The issue is reproducible on both Chrome and Safari.
exampleTrans: 这个问题在两个主流浏览器上都可以复现。

name: deterministic
example: Tests should be deterministic and never depend on the current time.
exampleTrans: 测试应该是确定性的，永远不依赖当前时间。

name: consistently
example: The export fails consistently when the file exceeds ten megabytes.
exampleTrans: 当文件超过十兆时，导出总是失败。

name: occasionally
example: The app occasionally freezes when switching between tabs.
exampleTrans: 切换标签页时应用偶尔会卡住。

name: crash
example: The app crashes when I rotate the screen during upload.
exampleTrans: 上传过程中旋转屏幕时应用会崩溃。

name: freeze
example: The page freezes for several seconds after clicking save.
exampleTrans: 点击保存后页面会卡住好几秒。

name: hang
example: The installer hangs at ninety percent on older machines.
exampleTrans: 在旧机器上安装程序会在百分之九十处挂起。

name: error message
trans: n. 错误信息；报错提示
example: The error message should tell users how to fix the problem.
exampleTrans: 错误信息应该告诉用户如何解决问题。

name: screenshot
example: Attach a screenshot showing the wrong total on the invoice.
exampleTrans: 附上一张显示发票总额错误的截图。

name: screen recording
example: A short screen recording makes this animation bug much easier to understand.
exampleTrans: 一段简短的录屏能让这个动画缺陷更容易理解。

name: attachment
example: The attachment includes the HAR file and console output.
exampleTrans: 附件中包含网络抓包文件和控制台输出。

name: bug report
example: A good bug report lets developers fix the issue without asking questions.
exampleTrans: 好的缺陷报告能让开发不用追问就修复问题。

name: issue
example: This issue only affects users with a non-English locale.
exampleTrans: 这个问题只影响非英语区域设置的用户。

name: bug tracker
example: Every defect must be recorded in the bug tracker.
exampleTrans: 每个缺陷都必须记录在缺陷跟踪系统中。

name: duplicate
example: I closed this ticket as a duplicate of the earlier report.
exampleTrans: 我把这个工单作为早先报告的重复项关闭了。

name: works as designed
trans: phr. 设计如此；按设计运行
example: The developer marked the ticket works as designed and closed it.
exampleTrans: 开发把这个工单标记为设计如此并关闭了。

name: won't fix
example: The team decided won't fix because the feature is being removed.
exampleTrans: 团队决定不予修复，因为该功能即将下线。

name: reopen
example: I reopened the bug because the fix does not work on mobile.
exampleTrans: 我重新打开了这个缺陷，因为修复在移动端无效。

name: fixed
example: The ticket is marked fixed but I still see the error.
exampleTrans: 工单已标记为已修复，但我仍然看到这个错误。

name: resolved
example: Resolved bugs need QA verification before they can be closed.
exampleTrans: 已解决的缺陷需要测试验证后才能关闭。

name: verified
example: I moved the ticket to verified after retesting on the new build.
exampleTrans: 在新构建上复测后，我把工单改为已验证。

name: retest
example: Please retest the checkout flow after the hotfix is deployed.
exampleTrans: 热修复部署后请复测结账流程。

name: cannot reproduce
example: The developer marked it cannot reproduce, so I added more details.
exampleTrans: 开发标记为无法复现，所以我补充了更多细节。

name: test result
example: Test results are published to the team dashboard after each run.
exampleTrans: 每次运行后，测试结果都会发布到团队看板上。

name: pass
example: All two hundred cases passed on the release candidate.
exampleTrans: 全部两百个用例在候选发布版本上都通过了。

name: fail
example: Three tests failed because of a changed API response.
exampleTrans: 有三个测试因为接口返回变了而失败。

name: pass rate
example: The pass rate improved to ninety-eight percent this week.
exampleTrans: 本周通过率提高到了百分之九十八。

name: skip
example: We skip the payment tests when the sandbox is unavailable.
exampleTrans: 当沙箱不可用时，我们跳过支付测试。

name: test execution
example: Test execution is sixty percent complete as of today.
exampleTrans: 截至今天，测试执行已完成百分之六十。

name: test run
trans: n. 测试运行；一轮测试
example: The last test run had four failures, all in the search module.
exampleTrans: 上一轮测试有四个失败，全部在搜索模块。

name: test cycle
trans: n. 测试周期；测试轮次
example: We plan two test cycles before the code freeze.
exampleTrans: 我们计划在代码冻结前进行两个测试轮次。

name: test report
example: I will send the test report to stakeholders by Friday.
exampleTrans: 我会在周五前把测试报告发给相关方。

name: test strategy
example: Our test strategy focuses on automation at the API layer.
exampleTrans: 我们的测试策略侧重于接口层的自动化。

name: test scenario
example: Each test scenario may contain several detailed test cases.
exampleTrans: 每个测试场景可能包含多个详细的测试用例。

name: in scope
example: Only the mobile web version is in scope for this round.
exampleTrans: 本轮只有移动网页版在测试范围内。

name: entry criteria
example: Entry criteria include a stable build and completed unit tests.
exampleTrans: 准入标准包括稳定的构建和已完成的单元测试。

name: exit criteria
trans: n. 退出标准；准出标准
example: We meet exit criteria when no critical or major bugs remain open.
exampleTrans: 当没有未关闭的致命或严重缺陷时，我们达到退出标准。

name: acceptance criteria
example: I wrote test cases directly from the story's acceptance criteria.
exampleTrans: 我直接根据用户故事的验收标准编写测试用例。

name: specification
example: The specification does not say what happens with negative amounts.
exampleTrans: 规格说明没有说明金额为负数时会怎样。

name: traceability
example: The traceability matrix links each requirement to its test cases.
exampleTrans: 可追溯性矩阵将每条需求关联到对应的测试用例。

name: positive test
example: The positive test confirms login works with valid credentials.
exampleTrans: 正向测试确认使用有效凭据可以登录。

name: negative test
trans: n. 反向测试；异常测试
example: Add a negative test for an expired coupon code.
exampleTrans: 为过期优惠码添加一个反向测试。

name: happy path
example: The happy path works, but error handling is incomplete.
exampleTrans: 主流程能跑通，但错误处理不完整。

name: equivalence class
example: We split the age field into three equivalence classes.
exampleTrans: 我们把年龄字段划分成了三个等价类。

name: invalid input
example: The server should reject invalid input with a clear message.
exampleTrans: 服务器应该以清晰的提示拒绝无效输入。

name: off-by-one
example: The last page is missing because of an off-by-one error.
exampleTrans: 由于差一错误，最后一页丢失了。

name: black-box
example: Black-box testing focuses on inputs and outputs, not the code.
exampleTrans: 黑盒测试关注输入和输出，而不是代码。

name: white-box
example: White-box tests helped us cover every branch of the parser.
exampleTrans: 白盒测试帮助我们覆盖了解析器的每个分支。

name: API testing
example: API testing catches most business logic bugs before the UI is ready.
exampleTrans: 接口测试能在界面完成前发现大部分业务逻辑缺陷。

name: status code
example: Check that the status code is 201 after creating an order.
exampleTrans: 创建订单后检查状态码是否为二零一。

name: response time
example: Average response time must stay under five hundred milliseconds.
exampleTrans: 平均响应时间必须保持在五百毫秒以内。

name: concurrent
example: Two concurrent updates to the same record caused data loss.
exampleTrans: 对同一条记录的两次并发更新导致了数据丢失。

name: race condition
example: The intermittent failure was caused by a race condition.
exampleTrans: 这个偶发失败是由竞态条件引起的。

name: memory leak
example: Memory usage keeps rising, which suggests a memory leak.
exampleTrans: 内存占用持续上升，表明存在内存泄漏。

name: usability
example: Usability feedback suggests the error messages are confusing.
exampleTrans: 易用性反馈表明错误提示令人困惑。

name: accessibility
trans: n. 无障碍性；可访问性
example: Accessibility testing found several images without any alternative text.
exampleTrans: 无障碍测试发现了缺少替代文本的图片。

name: compatibility
example: We run compatibility tests on the four most popular browsers.
exampleTrans: 我们在四个最常用的浏览器上进行兼容性测试。

name: cross-browser
example: Cross-browser testing revealed a layout bug in older Safari versions.
exampleTrans: 跨浏览器测试发现了旧版浏览器中的一个布局缺陷。

name: localization
example: Localization testing found truncated text in the German version.
exampleTrans: 本地化测试在德语版本中发现了被截断的文字。

name: security testing
example: Security testing found that the session token never expires.
exampleTrans: 安全测试发现会话令牌永不过期。

name: penetration test
example: An external team will run a penetration test next quarter.
exampleTrans: 外部团队将在下季度进行渗透测试。

name: injection
example: The search box is vulnerable to SQL injection.
exampleTrans: 搜索框存在数据库注入漏洞。

name: test runner
example: The test runner retries failed cases once before reporting.
exampleTrans: 测试运行器会在报告前对失败用例重试一次。

name: setup
example: The setup step seeds the database with sample orders.
exampleTrans: 准备步骤会向数据库写入示例订单。

name: teardown
example: The teardown deletes all users created during the test.
exampleTrans: 清理步骤会删除测试中创建的所有用户。

name: locator
example: The locator broke after the developers renamed the button ID.
exampleTrans: 开发修改按钮标识后，元素定位器失效了。

name: selector
example: Use a stable data attribute as the selector instead of CSS classes.
exampleTrans: 使用稳定的数据属性作为选择器，而不是样式类名。

name: page object
example: The page object model keeps our UI tests easy to maintain.
exampleTrans: 页面对象模式让我们的界面测试易于维护。

name: headless
example: We run the browser in headless mode on the CI server.
exampleTrans: 我们在持续集成服务器上以无头模式运行浏览器。

name: retry
example: Automatic retry hides real problems, so use it carefully.
exampleTrans: 自动重试会掩盖真实问题，所以要谨慎使用。

name: parallel
example: Running tests in parallel cut the build time in half.
exampleTrans: 并行运行测试让构建时间减少了一半。

name: data-driven
example: A data-driven test reads its inputs from a spreadsheet.
exampleTrans: 数据驱动的测试从表格中读取输入。

name: parameterize
example: Parameterize the test so it runs with every supported currency.
exampleTrans: 把测试参数化，使它针对每种支持的货币运行。

name: test double
example: A test double replaces the real service during unit tests.
exampleTrans: 在单元测试中，测试替身会替代真实服务。

name: continuous delivery
example: Continuous delivery depends on a reliable automated test suite.
exampleTrans: 持续交付依赖于可靠的自动化测试套件。

name: roll back
example: If the smoke test fails in production, roll back immediately.
exampleTrans: 如果生产环境冒烟测试失败，立即回滚。

name: release candidate
example: The second release candidate passed all regression tests.
exampleTrans: 第二个候选发布版本通过了所有回归测试。

name: code freeze
example: Only blocker fixes are allowed after the code freeze.
exampleTrans: 代码冻结后只允许修复阻塞性问题。

name: go-live
example: The go-live is postponed until the data migration is verified.
exampleTrans: 上线推迟到数据迁移验证完成之后。

name: rollout
example: We will monitor errors closely during the staged rollout.
exampleTrans: 在分阶段发布期间我们会密切监控错误。

name: known issue
example: This is a known issue and is listed in the release notes.
exampleTrans: 这是一个已知问题，已列在发布说明中。

name: go no-go
example: QA presents the open bug list at the go no-go meeting.
exampleTrans: 测试团队在发布决策会上汇报未关闭缺陷清单。

name: quality gate
example: The quality gate requires at least eighty percent coverage on new code.
exampleTrans: 质量门禁要求新代码覆盖率至少达到百分之八十。

name: QA
trans: n. 质量保证；测试团队
example: QA found the issue during the final regression run.
exampleTrans: 测试团队在最后一轮回归中发现了这个问题。

name: tester
example: Each tester owns one feature area during the sprint.
exampleTrans: 每个测试人员在迭代中负责一个功能领域。

name: shift left
example: We shift left by reviewing requirements before coding starts.
exampleTrans: 我们通过在编码前评审需求来实现测试左移。

name: risk-based
example: Risk-based testing helps us focus on payment and login first.
exampleTrans: 基于风险的测试帮助我们优先关注支付和登录。

name: defect density
example: Defect density is highest in the legacy billing module.
exampleTrans: 缺陷密度在旧的计费模块中最高。

name: escaped defect
trans: n. 漏测缺陷；逃逸缺陷
example: We review every escaped defect to improve our test cases.
exampleTrans: 我们会复盘每个漏测缺陷来改进测试用例。

name: false positive
example: The scanner flagged a false positive in the generated code.
exampleTrans: 扫描工具在生成的代码中报了一个误报。

name: false negative
example: A false negative means the test passed but the bug was real.
exampleTrans: 漏报是指测试通过了，但缺陷确实存在。

name: baseline
example: Compare today's results against the baseline from last release.
exampleTrans: 把今天的结果和上个版本的基线进行对比。

name: benchmark
example: The benchmark shows the new parser is thirty percent faster.
exampleTrans: 基准测试显示新解析器快了百分之三十。

name: snapshot
example: Update the snapshot only if the visual change is intentional.
exampleTrans: 只有在视觉变化是有意为之时才更新快照。

name: visual regression
example: Visual regression tests caught the shifted header logo.
exampleTrans: 视觉回归测试发现了页眉标志的位移。

name: static analysis
example: Static analysis flagged an unused variable and a possible null access.
exampleTrans: 静态分析标出了一个未使用的变量和一处可能的空值访问。

name: mutation testing
example: Mutation testing showed several assertions were too weak.
exampleTrans: 变异测试表明有几个断言太弱。

name: branch coverage
example: Branch coverage is low because error paths are not tested.
exampleTrans: 分支覆盖率低，因为错误路径没有被测试。

name: code coverage
example: High code coverage does not guarantee the logic is correct.
exampleTrans: 高代码覆盖率并不能保证逻辑正确。

name: contract test
example: Contract tests ensure the client and service agree on the API.
exampleTrans: 契约测试确保客户端和服务在接口上保持一致。

name: test account
example: Use the shared test account with an expired subscription.
exampleTrans: 请使用订阅已过期的共享测试账号。

name: sandbox
example: All payment tests run against the provider's sandbox.
exampleTrans: 所有支付测试都在服务商的沙箱环境中运行。

name: emulator
example: It works on the emulator but crashes on a real phone.
exampleTrans: 它在模拟器上正常，但在真机上崩溃。

name: console
example: The browser console shows a JavaScript error after clicking submit.
exampleTrans: 点击提交后，浏览器控制台显示一个脚本错误。

name: investigate
example: I am still investigating why the job fails only at night.
exampleTrans: 我还在排查为什么这个任务只在夜间失败。

name: isolate
example: I isolated the issue to the new caching layer.
exampleTrans: 我把问题定位到了新的缓存层。

name: narrow down
example: Can you narrow down which build first showed the problem?
exampleTrans: 你能缩小范围，找到最先出现这个问题的构建版本吗？

name: introduce
example: The refactoring introduced a bug in date formatting.
exampleTrans: 这次重构在日期格式化中引入了一个缺陷。

name: affect
example: This bug affects all users who signed up with a phone number.
exampleTrans: 这个缺陷影响所有用手机号注册的用户。

name: impact
example: The business impact is high because orders cannot be placed.
exampleTrans: 业务影响很大，因为无法下单。

name: behavior
example: The current behavior differs from what the design shows.
exampleTrans: 当前行为与设计稿不一致。

name: unexpected
example: The API returns an unexpected null in the address field.
exampleTrans: 接口在地址字段中返回了一个非预期的空值。

name: inconsistent
example: The totals are inconsistent between the cart and the invoice.
exampleTrans: 购物车和发票中的总额不一致。

name: broken
example: The reset password link is broken in the latest build.
exampleTrans: 最新构建中重置密码的链接失效了。

name: truncated
example: Long product names are truncated without an ellipsis.
exampleTrans: 长商品名称被截断了，并且没有省略号。

name: misaligned
example: The icons are misaligned with the text on tablets.
exampleTrans: 在平板上图标与文字没有对齐。

name: unresponsive
example: The page becomes unresponsive after uploading a large file.
exampleTrans: 上传大文件后页面变得无响应。

name: degraded
trans: adj. 降级的；性能下降的
example: Search is degraded but still usable during the migration.
exampleTrans: 迁移期间搜索功能有所降级，但仍可使用。

name: stable
example: The build is stable enough to start the full regression.
exampleTrans: 这个构建已足够稳定，可以开始全量回归。

name: unstable
example: The test environment has been unstable all week.
exampleTrans: 测试环境整周都不稳定。

name: maintainable
example: Keep test code clean and maintainable like production code.
exampleTrans: 要像对待生产代码一样，让测试代码整洁且可维护。

name: reliable
example: Our goal is a reliable suite that the team actually trusts.
exampleTrans: 我们的目标是一个团队真正信任的可靠测试套件。

name: blocked
example: Testing is blocked until the login service is fixed.
exampleTrans: 在登录服务修复之前，测试被阻塞。

name: pending
example: Three bugs are pending verification on the new build.
exampleTrans: 有三个缺陷在等待在新构建上验证。

name: outstanding
trans: adj. 未解决的；未完成的
example: How many outstanding critical bugs do we have for this release?
exampleTrans: 这个版本我们还有多少未解决的致命缺陷？

name: open
example: There are still five open bugs assigned to the mobile team.
exampleTrans: 还有五个未关闭的缺陷分配给移动端团队。

name: assign
example: I assigned the bug to the developer who wrote the feature.
exampleTrans: 我把这个缺陷指派给了开发该功能的开发人员。

name: defer
example: The team agreed to defer the minor bugs to the next release.
exampleTrans: 团队同意把轻微缺陷推迟到下个版本。

name: risk
example: Skipping regression on this module is a high risk.
exampleTrans: 跳过这个模块的回归测试风险很高。

name: monitor
example: We will monitor error rates for an hour after deployment.
exampleTrans: 部署后我们会监控错误率一个小时。

name: metric
example: Defect leakage is the key quality metric we track monthly.
exampleTrans: 缺陷泄漏率是我们每月跟踪的关键质量指标。

name: checklist
example: Follow the release checklist before approving the deployment.
exampleTrans: 批准部署前请按发布检查清单执行。

name: ad hoc
example: We did some ad hoc testing on the new filters.
exampleTrans: 我们对新的筛选功能做了一些临时测试。

name: pairwise
example: Pairwise testing reduced our configuration combinations from 200 to 15.
exampleTrans: 成对测试把我们的配置组合从两百个减少到十五个。

name: state transition
example: Draw a state transition diagram for the order lifecycle.
exampleTrans: 为订单生命周期画一张状态迁移图。

name: decision table
example: A decision table helped us cover every discount rule combination.
exampleTrans: 判定表帮助我们覆盖了所有折扣规则的组合。

name: beta testing
example: Beta testing with real users found two major usability problems.
exampleTrans: 与真实用户进行的公测发现了两个严重的易用性问题。

name: A-B testing
example: A-B testing showed the new button increased sign-ups.
exampleTrans: A/B 测试显示新按钮提高了注册量。

name: canary
example: The canary release went to five percent of users first.
exampleTrans: 金丝雀发布先推给了百分之五的用户。

name: data integrity
example: We added checks for data integrity after each import.
exampleTrans: 我们在每次导入后都增加了数据完整性检查。

name: recovery
example: Recovery testing checks the system restarts cleanly after a crash.
exampleTrans: 恢复测试检查系统在崩溃后能否正常重启。

name: failover
example: During failover, users should not see any errors.
exampleTrans: 在故障转移期间，用户不应看到任何错误。

name: soak test
trans: n. 浸泡测试；长时间稳定性测试
example: The overnight soak test revealed slow memory growth.
exampleTrans: 通宵的稳定性测试发现了缓慢的内存增长。

name: peak load
example: The system must handle peak load during the holiday sale.
exampleTrans: 系统必须承受节日促销期间的峰值负载。

name: reset
example: Reset the environment so each run starts from a clean state.
exampleTrans: 重置环境，让每次运行都从干净的状态开始。

name: side effect
example: The fix had a side effect on the export feature.
exampleTrans: 这个修复对导出功能产生了副作用。

name: regress
example: Search performance regressed noticeably after the latest merge.
exampleTrans: 最近一次合并后搜索性能出现了退化。

name: sporadic
example: We see sporadic failures in the upload test on CI.
exampleTrans: 在持续集成上，上传测试偶尔会失败。

name: non-functional
example: Our non-functional requirements include speed, security and availability.
exampleTrans: 非功能性需求包括速度、安全性和可用性。

name: quarantine
example: We quarantine flaky tests until someone fixes them.
exampleTrans: 我们会把不稳定的测试隔离起来，直到有人修复。

name: test pyramid
example: The test pyramid favors fast unit tests over expensive browser tests.
exampleTrans: 测试金字塔倾向于快速单元测试，而非昂贵的浏览器测试。

name: test matrix
example: The test matrix covers supported browsers, devices, and operating systems.
exampleTrans: 测试矩阵覆盖受支持的浏览器、设备和操作系统。

name: test basis
example: Approved requirements provide the test basis for release validation.
exampleTrans: 已批准的需求为发布验证提供测试依据。

name: test objective
example: Each test objective states the risk we intend to evaluate.
exampleTrans: 每个测试目标都说明我们要评估的风险。

name: test condition
example: This test condition verifies checkout with an expired card.
exampleTrans: 这个测试条件验证使用过期银行卡结账的情况。

name: test oracle
example: The accounting ledger serves as our test oracle for totals.
exampleTrans: 会计账本充当总额校验的测试预言机。

name: test coverage gap
example: The test coverage gap involves retries after partial payment failure.
exampleTrans: 测试覆盖缺口涉及部分付款失败后的重试。

name: equivalence partitioning
example: Equivalence partitioning reduces redundant cases for similar input ranges.
exampleTrans: 等价类划分减少了相似输入范围的冗余用例。

name: boundary value analysis
example: Boundary value analysis targets limits around the allowed file size.
exampleTrans: 边界值分析针对允许文件大小附近的界限。

name: cause effect graph
example: A cause effect graph maps discount rules to expected outcomes.
exampleTrans: 因果图将折扣规则映射到预期结果。

name: orthogonal array
example: An orthogonal array limits combinations while preserving useful coverage.
exampleTrans: 正交数组在保留有效覆盖的同时限制组合数量。

name: session-based testing
example: Session-based testing gives exploratory work a clear charter and duration.
exampleTrans: 基于会话的测试为探索性工作设定明确章程和时长。

name: test charter
example: The test charter focuses exploration on failed subscription renewals.
exampleTrans: 探索性测试章程把探索重点放在订阅续费失败上。

name: error guessing
example: Error guessing uses tester experience to target likely failures.
exampleTrans: 错误推测法利用测试人员经验定位可能的故障。

name: risk assessment
example: The risk assessment prioritizes payment and data loss scenarios.
exampleTrans: 风险评估优先考虑支付和数据丢失场景。

name: risk coverage
example: Risk coverage improved after adding recovery and failover scenarios.
exampleTrans: 增加恢复和故障转移场景后，风险覆盖得到改善。

name: defect leakage
example: Defect leakage fell after we expanded pre-release compatibility testing.
exampleTrans: 扩大上线前兼容性测试后，缺陷泄漏减少了。

name: defect removal efficiency
example: Defect removal efficiency measures issues caught before production.
exampleTrans: 缺陷消除效率衡量生产环境之前发现的问题。

name: defect lifecycle
example: The defect lifecycle defines transitions from discovery through closure.
exampleTrans: 缺陷生命周期定义了从发现到关闭的状态转换。

name: defect clustering
example: Defect clustering suggests the import module needs deeper testing.
exampleTrans: 缺陷聚集表明导入模块需要更深入的测试。

name: bug bash
example: The bug bash uncovered localization issues before the regional launch.
exampleTrans: 集中找错活动在区域上线前发现了本地化问题。

name: release blocker
example: Data corruption makes this issue a release blocker.
exampleTrans: 数据损坏使这个问题成为发布阻断缺陷。

name: known limitation
example: Document the known limitation in the customer release notes.
exampleTrans: 请在客户发布说明中记录这项已知限制。

name: false failure
example: A stale fixture caused the false failure in nightly tests.
exampleTrans: 过期的测试夹具导致夜间测试出现假失败。

name: test isolation
example: Test isolation prevents one scenario from contaminating another.
exampleTrans: 测试隔离可防止一个场景污染另一个场景。

name: testability
example: Stable selectors improve testability without changing visible behavior.
exampleTrans: 稳定的选择器在不改变可见行为的情况下提高可测试性。

name: service virtualization
example: Service virtualization simulates the unavailable tax provider during integration testing.
exampleTrans: 服务虚拟化在集成测试期间模拟不可用的税务服务方。

name: record and playback
example: Record and playback accelerated creation of basic regression scripts.
exampleTrans: 录制回放加快了基础回归脚本的创建。

name: keyword-driven testing
example: Keyword-driven testing lets domain experts assemble reusable business flows.
exampleTrans: 关键字驱动测试让领域专家组合可复用的业务流程。

name: screenplay pattern
example: The screenplay pattern models user abilities instead of page structure.
exampleTrans: Screenplay 测试模式以用户能力而非页面结构建模。

name: wait condition
example: Use a wait condition instead of a fixed delay.
exampleTrans: 请使用等待条件，而不是固定延迟。

name: implicit wait
example: An implicit wait can hide slow and unstable selectors.
exampleTrans: 隐式等待可能掩盖缓慢且不稳定的选择器。

name: explicit wait
example: The explicit wait ends when the confirmation banner appears.
exampleTrans: 确认横幅出现时，显式等待就会结束。

name: contract testing
example: Contract testing detects incompatible API changes before integration.
exampleTrans: 契约测试在集成前发现不兼容的 API 变更。

name: consumer-driven contract
example: A consumer-driven contract captures each client's required interactions.
exampleTrans: 消费者驱动契约记录每个客户端所需的交互。

name: schema validation
example: Schema validation rejects responses missing mandatory customer fields.
exampleTrans: 模式校验会拒绝缺少必填客户字段的响应。

name: chaos testing
example: Chaos testing verifies recovery when a service instance disappears.
exampleTrans: 混沌测试验证服务实例消失时的恢复能力。

name: fault injection
example: Fault injection exposed an endless retry loop in checkout.
exampleTrans: 故障注入暴露了结账流程中的无限重试循环。

name: accessibility testing
example: Accessibility testing covers keyboard flow, labels, and screen readers.
exampleTrans: 无障碍测试覆盖键盘流程、标签和屏幕阅读器。
